arm_definition.neutral: Pinned control project alone in an isolated workspace. No WCBS, EOS, or globally installed plugin state is staged.
arm_definition.wcbs: The identical pinned control project with only the exact V2 WCBS candidate Git archive installed through scripts/wcbs.mjs into an isolated plugin directory.

requirements: Before the first paid run, commit the exact agent version, full immutable model identifier, credential variable name, and vendor-documented non-interactive command template.
Use exactly the same agent version, model, tool access, context conditions, budget, and one protected per-record runtime profile across all arms.
The WCBS agent command template must carry the same {{plugin_dir}} supplied to the WCBS loader; a loader that cannot affect the agent process is invalid.
Aliases such as sonnet, opus, or latest are forbidden.
execution_identity.state: BLOCKED: immutable execution identity and vendor-documented agent command are intentionally not invented by this repository.

loader_state: BLOCKED: a vendor-documented Claude loader template has not been recorded. WCBS staging uses V2 wcbs.mjs, but no claimed native loader is fabricated.

phase5.pass_rule: PASS only if WCBS success is at least 0.90 and the observed absolute lift over neutral is at least 0.20.

randomization.method: seeded Fisher-Yates schedule over every case-arm-repetition record
randomization.seed_requirement: A safe seed is required at execute time and is retained in the run manifest before the first invocation.
randomization.order: The generated schedule, not canonical arm order, controls execution.
